data.source: Pinterest production API v5 public-pin metrics plus GA4 and first-party database acquisition checks
caveats: Captured about 40 hours after publication, the first scheduled run after the 24-hour checkpoint became due.
The Pin has not yet received measurable public distribution, so zero engagement cannot distinguish Arm B headline quality from lack of delivery.
The full truthful public profile measured 253 impressions, two Pin clicks, one save, and zero outbound clicks; Pinterest v3 and Sandbox objects are excluded.
GA4 recorded 29 sessions in the trailing seven days and no Pinterest source; the first-party database recorded zero product clicks in the trailing seven days.
Revenue remains unavailable from the current affiliate reporting path and is null.
